name: Bristleback Belt
summary: In Camp Narache, young tauren gather Bristleback Belts to prove their valor. The belts come from quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine and mark a step in the Rite of Strength.

sections.title: Proof of the Rite
sections.body: The Red Cloud tribe tests youths who seek respect in Thunder Bluff through the ancient Rites of the Earthmother. The first trial, the Rite of Strength, asks each initiate to protect the tribe from threats. Bristleback quilboar raid food supplies and ambush hunting parties outside Camp Narache. Chief Hawkwind demands their belts in return. Bringing him twelve proves an initiate can face danger and help defend the tribe.

sections.title: Quilboar Craft
sections.body: Bristleback warriors and shamans in Brambleblade Ravine wear belts made from rough hide, twine, and scrap. A tauren warrior has little use for one as apparel, but its quilboar make marks it as evidence of a slain enemy. Bringing the belts back to the camp circle fulfills the rite's proof.

faq.q: What are Bristleback Belts used for?
aliases: why do i need bristleback belt
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache asks for twelve Bristleback Belts as proof that an initiate has completed the Rite of Strength, the first of the traditional Rites of the Earthmother.

faq.q: Where do Bristleback Belts come from?
faq.answer: Bristleback quilboar and shamans in Brambleblade Ravine, just east of Camp Narache in the Red Cloud Mesa, wear the belts.

faq.q: Why does Chief Hawkwind want belts instead of heads or weapons?
faq.answer: The belts provide portable proof that an initiate has slain enemies of the tribe. The rite calls for belts but does not explain why they were chosen over other trophies.

faq.q: Why are the Bristlebacks being targeted?
faq.answer: Bristlebacks have encroached on tribal land from Brambleblade Ravine. They raid Camp Narache by night and ambush tauren hunting parties across the mesa.

angles.text: As a tauren youth on the Red Cloud Mesa, taking a fallen Bristleback's belt marks your first step toward recognition by the elders in Thunder Bluff.
As a member of the Horde, curbing Mulgore's aggressive quilboar helps secure the southern borders of the Horde's heartland in central Kalimdor.
